description: Kept Nick's mornings unpriced and unbegun.
name: Augustine Phillips

description: Refused to reopen Monday and refused to turn the stock into a balance.
name: George Bryan

description: Stated the thirty-eight, left the eightpence and the ten shillings where they were, and set Tuesday without him.
name: John Heminges

description: Told him to call it a share and to walk it home.
name: Richard Burbage

description: Kept this week distinct from the fourth of October, and would not drink the figure.
name: Thomas Pope

description: Refused another Richmond speech and chose home.
name: Will Kemp

description: Entered 38s and closed the book on a blank.
name: William Shakespeare
